record.paper_title: Highlights and Open Questions from ZEUS
record.original_question: How does a pomeron structure emerge from QCD in HERA diffraction? More specifically, given that a single soft pomeron does not describe all diffractive data and that increasing Q^2 or vector-meson mass leads to rapidly rising cross-sections with W^2, what QCD description correctly accounts for the exchanged diffractive object measured in deep inelastic scattering?

evidence.quote: The study of diffractive phenomena and their relation to the inclusive cross-section at HERA may hold the key to understanding how a "pomeron" structure emerges from QCD. What we have learned so far is that a single soft pomeron does not describe all diffractive data measured at HERA.

artifact.category_tag: Pomeron in QCD and diffractive DIS
artifact.status_search_result: The QCD origin of the pomeron and the proper description of the diffractive exchange in DIS remain an active and unresolved research area. Reviews and monographs (e.g., Forshaw–Ross, Donnachie–Dosch–Landshoff–Nachtmann) describe partial progress via BFKL resummation, two-gluon exchange and dipole models, but emphasize that the matching of soft and hard pomeron regimes and the non-perturbative structure of the pomeron are not derived from first-principles QCD. The problem is therefore considered open.

status_evidence.title: Pomeron Physics and QCD
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses soft and hard pomerons and the unresolved question of their unification within QCD.
status_evidence.claim: The non-perturbative structure of the pomeron and the soft/hard transition remain open problems.

status_evidence.title: Diffraction in QCD
status_evidence.snippet: While the perturbative pomeron is defined as two-Reggeized-gluon exchange, its non-perturbative structure is basically unknown.
status_evidence.claim: A first-principles QCD description of the pomeron is still lacking.

status_evidence.title: Measurement and QCD analysis of the diffractive DIS cross section at HERA
status_evidence.snippet: QCD analysis of diffractive parton distributions at HERA.
status_evidence.claim: Diffractive DIS data are described phenomenologically via QCD-evolved diffractive PDFs, but the dynamical QCD origin of the pomeron is not derived.
